Reads the technique table through BtlSuper_GetAiKind while the opponent is in a technique action (BtlAct_IsTechniqueId).

Only forwards (set, idxA, idxB) to EftChain_SetTex, which copies two texture entries of the set.
Per-channel flag of the colour multiplier pulse (eft_link_2.c:1616 tests 0x2000 for mul[0]); likewise SCALEY/SCALEZ -> MUL_G/MUL_B.
eft_link_2.c:1619 tests 0x4000 for the green multiplier.
eft_link_2.c:1622 tests 0x8000 for the blue multiplier.
eft_link_2.c:1679-1686: with 0x80 the colour runs from col0 along colDelta; set from def->colorMode (eft_part10.c:296-301).
Writes the word eft_link_2.c:1437 reads as the emitter's life in seconds.

It tests byte +0x0A of the emitter definition, which is the node slot in EftSetDef / EftEmitDef, not a kind.
Its whole body is gEftSurf->param30 = v, the specular factor of the surface parameters.
It stores seconds at arg +0x34 and seconds * 30 at work +0x174, the life EftZap_Update counts down (eft_ribbon.c w->life).
It returns the position and facing yaw of entry 0 of StgDataA.starts (stage data +0x2C).
it tests bit 0 of the movie's trigger word (Flash.trig, set for one frame by the movie's action "trig" "0"); the callers start an animation and wait for it to become non-zero before going on.
it stores into the box's shadow colour, which TextBox_DrawClip hands to Font_SetShadowColor.
the flag TextBox_SetColor2 sets; it selects box->shadow over the default shadow colour in TB_ATTACH.
it stores the four values TextBox_DrawClip hands to Font_SetClip (argument order x0, x1, y0, y1).
the flag TextBox_SetRect sets; it selects box->clip over the full-screen clip in TB_ATTACH.
its whole body is TextBox_SetSpacing(&gMsgWin->box, a, b).
both callers store the result as the item slot capacity (ItemSet_Fit's capacity argument).
